card.name: Just before a target or desired value
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words right before a target or desired value appears, such as an opening parenthesis in a dose formula, a quote mark before 'desirable', or 'a' before 'target range'. Mostly in dosing formulas and target tables.

modes.label: Dose formula openers
modes.description: Opening parenthesis or equals sign in a formula that leads to a target concentration or desired value.
modes.example: new sirolimus oral solution dose = current dose x<< (>>target concentration/current concentration).
